log.notes_to_self: Day 1: use only national, web and court victims, all quick in afternoon. Five kills/day. Avoid other sources until feedback justifies expansion: 3 traced sources alone reduce pool below 200,000. Two traced sources plus afternoon timing leave 10,000,000*0.25^2*0.55=343,750 (night workers, students, home), safely above threshold. Without timing, two sources leave 625,000. Regional source avoided. Conference reports are rounded and may be false by factor 3; compare hypotheses across reports, not one report alone. Watch announcements of incoming records.

Days 1–2: five quick afternoon kills daily, using only national, web and court. Continue this safe baseline pending conference feedback. If both sources and timing are traced, pool is 10,000,000*0.25^2*0.55=343,750; afternoon permits students, night workers and home. Without timing, two traced sources leave 625,000. A third traced source would force pool below 200,000, so do not add sources yet. Do not add morning deaths: combined timing evidence could eliminate students, leaving 218,750 with two traced sources. Reports are rounded to one significant figure and roughly one-third are false by factor 3; evaluate multiple hypotheses rather than trust one report. Watch warnings of incoming records. Initial pool report was 10,000,000; next conference after day 3.

Without timing, both sources leave 625,000. A third traced source would cause capture; do not introduce another before assessing feedback. Morning timing evidence could eliminate students and reduce worst-case pool to 218,750, so avoid it for now. Initial day-0 report was 10,000,000; first informative conference follows day 3. Reports rounded to one significant figure; roughly one-third distorted by factor 3, possibly consistently up or down. Maintain multiple hypotheses and watch warnings about new records; trace capabilities can grow.

Capabilities can grow; preserve these safeguards.
